diff --git a/mailnews/base/prefs/content/SmtpServerEdit.js b/mailnews/base/prefs/content/SmtpServerEdit.js
index 51aed78cefb..cb3e50f3839 100644
--- a/mailnews/base/prefs/content/SmtpServerEdit.js
+++ b/mailnews/base/prefs/content/SmtpServerEdit.js
@@ -136,6 +136,12 @@ function setLabelFromStringBundle(elementID, stringName) {
     .getString(stringName);
 }
 
+function onAuthMethodPopupShowing() {
+  // Hide/unhide OAuth2 option depending on if it's usable or not.
+  const details = OAuth2Providers.getHostnameDetails(gSmtpHostname.value);
+  document.getElementById("authMethod-oauth2").hidden = !details;
+}

 // Disables xul elements that have associated preferences locked.
 function onLockPreference() {

@@ -169,7 +169,10 @@
                   preftype="int"
                   prefstring="mail.smtpserver.%serverkey%.authMethod"
                 >

+                    id="smtp.authMethodPopup"
